citations.cites: Definition of Ordinance or Law and Undamaged Portion
Increased limit to 25% of Coverage A

facts: Kitchen fire on 2024-06-30 caused damage requiring rebuild.
City requires the rebuild, including undamaged rooms, to meet current building code, increasing construction cost to $40,000.
note: The loss triggers the Ordinance or Law endorsement because the rebuild must comply with current code, covering costs for undamaged portions (HO-0612_03-24#02). The endorsement provides an increased limit of 25% of Coverage A, which is $87,500, exceeding the quoted $40,000 cost (HO-0612_03-24#03). No exclusion language applies to this situation. [HO-0612_03-24#02] [HO-0612_03-24#03]
